# duplicate-index

- Dialects: mysql, postgres, sqlite
- Default: on

## Why

Two indexes with the same keys, order, uniqueness and predicate serve exactly the same queries. The copy only adds write cost and storage: every insert and update maintains both. The same holds for an index that repeats the primary key.

## Fix

Remove the repeated index from the model (a duplicated index tag, or an index that restates the primary key) and regenerate the schema. The finding names the index to drop and the one that stays.

## Exception

Rare: an index deliberately duplicated while another is built under it for a zero-downtime rebuild; remove the exclusion once the old index is dropped.

The same text is printed by `schemalens explain duplicate-index`. An exclusion needs a written reason. Back to the [rule index](README.md).
